specs.title: Risk score and deposit gating
specs.why: Turning no-show history into an automatic deposit requirement is the payoff for tracking it.
specs.scope: Compute a client risk score and require deposits from high-risk clients, with per-tenant thresholds.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add threshold columns to the `Tenant` model
acceptance: `computeRiskScore()` is deterministic for identical input, verified by `pnpm test`
A high-risk booking without deposit returns HTTP 402
An owner override in `app/(app)/calendar/page.tsx` bypasses the gate

specs.title: Waitlist auto-fill
specs.why: Refilling cancelled slots automatically recovers revenue the merchant would otherwise lose.
specs.scope: On cancellation, notify waitlisted clients in order; the first to pay keeps the slot.
tasks: Add `prisma/migrations/`: add a unique claim constraint
acceptance: Concurrent claims result in exactly one winner, verified by `pnpm test`
An unclaimed slot returns to open availability after 30 minutes
